about.title: About STUDIO KRÍA
about.subtitle: Independent Film Production
about.description: Studio Kría formed in 2023 at Borgarholtsskóla film program. The team has collaborated on diverse short films spanning concept development, scripting, production, shooting, and post-production. Their work has screened at festivals and earned awards. They aim to build a trusted production company handling projects from initial concept to final delivery — short films, commercials, music videos, promotional content — emphasizing that "good atmosphere on set translates directly to better collaboration." They've cultivated a strong Icelandic industry network for crewing projects as needed.
about.missionText: To produce films that challenge, inspire, and endure. We champion director-driven storytelling, sustainable production practices, and equitable industry standards.

termsList.title: Standard Terms
termsList.desc: Minimum rental: 1 day (24hrs). Week rate: 4× day rate. Month rate: 12× day rate. Prep day: 50% day rate. Weekend: Single day rate (Fri–Mon). Insurance: Required (cert. of currency).

termsList.title: Delivery & Transport
termsList.desc: Reykjavik metro: Free delivery/pickup. Keflavik Airport: €150 each way. Iceland nationwide: Quote on request. International: Carnet + freight arranged. Customs clearance: Included for Iceland. On-set tech support: Available.

termsList.title: Quality Assurance
termsList.desc: Pre-rental checkout (in-person or video). All gear serviced every 6 months. Lenses calibrated to ARRI/Zeiss specs. Sensors cleaned, firmware current. Spare bodies available for features. 24/7 emergency support line.
